title: The Dialogue as the Ground of Enlightenment (uplift 2026)

equations.section: 3 Reflective Dialogue as a Mirror of Thought
equations.meaning: A finite human readout of an encountered trace becomes significant only relative to a declared reader, context and question, not as a substance carried inside the trace itself.

equations.section: 6 Digital Yonisomanasīkāra as a Working Definition (6.1 Iteration); recalled 7.1
equations.text: Z_dlg[s,n+1] = F#_dlg( Z_dlg[s,n], u_H[s,n], u_AI[s,n], c[s,n], T[s,n] )
equations.meaning: The recursive dialogue stepper: each turn updates a shared dialogue state from the prior state, the human's and the AI's inputs, context, and lineage, rather than resetting at every exchange (Iteration).

equations.section: 7 AI as Mirror, Not Moral Agent
equations.meaning: Under the candidate contract, AI output is knowledge-like, not knowledge; fluency or the register of a wisdom tradition does not upgrade this status.

equations.section: 7 AI as Mirror, Not Moral Agent
equations.meaning: Non-collapse rule: a corresponding claimed gain from AI-mediated dialogue is not the same object as what the person can reconstruct once the AI is removed.

equations.section: 7.1 Difference, resistance, and retained human agency
equations.meaning: Three non-substitutable constitutive conditions (a readout-distinguishable Difference, an independent Resistance, and retained human Agency) for a human–AI exchange to count as expanding, rather than merely occupying, the human's understanding.

equations.label: unlabeled (§6, Framing bullet)
equations.section: 6 Digital Yonisomanasīkāra as a Working Definition
equations.meaning: Framing maps onto the pre-prompt human state producing a bounded articulation: the moral or cognitive intention behind a dialogue turn is part of H_t, not of the prompt text Q_t itself.

equations.label: unlabeled (§6, Integration bullet)
equations.section: 6 Digital Yonisomanasīkāra as a Working Definition
equations.text: H_{n+1} = U_H( H_n, Retain(E_n, μ_n, ρ_n^H), δ^world, X^other ),  with the explicit non-guarantee: Retain(E_n) > 0 ⇒ H_{n+1} ≠ H_n possible, not guaranteed
equations.meaning: Integration maps onto selective retention: translating a reflective exchange into behavioural change requires that a residue actually be retained, which is not automatic.

equations.label: P1
equations.section: 6.2 Minimal empirical predictions for the working definition
equations.text: Framing residual: under matched topic and matched AI model, dialogues that open with an explicit statement of moral or cognitive intention (Framing) will show higher rates of retained, unaided reconstruction at a later session than dialogues that open with a bare information request, after controlling for prior topic familiarity and response length.
equations.meaning: First minimal empirical prediction giving Digital Yonisomanasīkāra content beyond a naming exercise.

equations.label: P2
equations.section: 6.2 Minimal empirical predictions for the working definition
equations.text: Iteration without Integration is insufficient: recursive questioning (Iteration, Equation (2)) that is not followed by an explicit translation step (Integration, i.e. a retained update to H_{n+1}) will show no reliable advantage over a single-turn exchange on the same unaided-reconstruction measure.
equations.meaning: Second minimal empirical prediction; iteration alone should not be mistaken for retained gain.
